dialogues.jp: 「とは言ってもな……」

ぼんやりと窓辺の日向に｛たたず／佇｝みながら、グラウン
ドを見下ろす。
dialogues.en:
I stood in a sunny place by the window and looked down on
the school ground outside.
dialogues.text:
I stood in a sunny place by the window and looked down on
the school ground outside.

dialogues.jp:
当たり前ながら、自由参加の時点で主催者側に
回らない学生が帰っていく。
dialogues.en:
Participation is up to each student, so whoever isn't doing
anything for the party is going home already.
dialogues.text:
Participation is up to each student, so whoever isn't doing
anything for the party is going home already.

dialogues.jp:
かく言う俺も、別段これといってやることもな
く、部活にも入っていないので強制される作業
もない。
dialogues.en:
And I don't have anything to do since I'm not participating
as an individual and don't belong to any club activities.
dialogues.text:
And I don't have anything to do since I'm not participating
as an individual and don't belong to any club activities.

dialogues.jp: 「やはり帰るか……」
dialogues.en: "I should head home......"
dialogues.text: "I should head home......"

dialogues.jp:
こんなところで油を売ってるよりは、家に帰っ
て寝てしまうほうがいくらか健康的だ。
dialogues.en:
It's much more constructive to just go home and sleep than
stand around here doing nothing.
dialogues.text:
It's much more constructive to just go home and sleep than
stand around here doing nothing.

dialogues.jp:
中身のない鞄を肩にかついで、自主的に一足早
い春休みに入ることにする。
dialogues.en:
I decided to start my spring break already, and slung my
empty bag on my shoulder.
dialogues.text:
I decided to start my spring break already, and slung my
empty bag on my shoulder.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「あ、兄さんどこ行くの？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, niisan, where are you going?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, niisan, where are you going?"

dialogues.jp:
とことこ、と教室から出てきた音夢が寄ってく
る。
dialogues.en: Nemu came up to me as she came out of the class room.
dialogues.text: Nemu came up to me as she came out of the class room.

dialogues.jp: 「帰るんだよ」
dialogues.en: "I'm going home."
dialogues.text: "I'm going home."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「今回はなにもしないんですか？」
dialogues.en: "You aren't participating?"
dialogues.text: "You aren't participating?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「して欲しいのか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you want me to?"
dialogues.text: "Do you want me to?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「騒ぎしか起こしそうにないので、是非しない
　でください」
dialogues.en:
"I think you only make trouble, so please don't
participate."
dialogues.text:
"I think you only make trouble, so please don't
participate."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だろうな……」
dialogues.en: "I thought so......"
dialogues.text: "I thought so......"

dialogues.jp: 笑顔で｛けんせい／牽制｝をかけてくる音夢のおでこを押す。
dialogues.en: I pushed her forehead as she checked with me.
dialogues.text: I pushed her forehead as she checked with me.

dialogues.jp: 「お前は風紀委員の仕事か？」
dialogues.en: "Are you doing the school committee thing?"
dialogues.text: "Are you doing the school committee thing?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「ええ、準備をきっちりとしておかないと、な
　にが起こるか分からないし」
dialogues.en:
"Yes. We have to be prepared because we never know what will
happen."
dialogues.text:
"Yes. We have to be prepared because we never know what will
happen."

dialogues.jp:
俺の手をどかして、ちょっと寂しげに音夢が微
笑む。
dialogues.en: Nemu smiled sadly, moving my hand away.
dialogues.text: Nemu smiled sadly, moving my hand away.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「当日も、遊んでる暇なんてないでしょうね」
dialogues.en: "I'll probably have no time to enjoy the festival."
dialogues.text: "I'll probably have no time to enjoy the festival."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「大変だな」
dialogues.en: "Wow, that's too much."
dialogues.text: "Wow, that's too much."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「いいえ。今回はブラックリストに載っている
　兄さんが何もしないだけ、まだ楽ですよ」
dialogues.en:
"Oh no. It shouldn't be that bad since you won't be
participating."
dialogues.text:
"Oh no. It shouldn't be that bad since you won't be
participating."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「……そうか」

｛やぶ／藪｝からヤマタノオロチが出てきそうなので、顔
を合わせないように深く頷く。
dialogues.en:
I felt like the eight-headed serpent's coming out of the
bushes, so I looked down and nodded deeply.
dialogues.text:
I felt like the eight-headed serpent's coming out of the
bushes, so I looked down and nodded deeply.

dialogues.jp: 「あんまり頑張るなよ」
dialogues.en: "Don't work too hard."
dialogues.text: "Don't work too hard."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なにそれ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp:
「お前は遠足の前日に興奮で眠れなくて、当日
　を駄目にするタイプだからな」
dialogues.en:
"You always get too excited the day before and ruin the
day."
dialogues.text:
"You always get too excited the day before and ruin the
day."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「はいはい……了解しました」
dialogues.en: "Okay...... I got that."
dialogues.text: "Okay...... I got that."

dialogues.jp:
いまいち反省のない音夢に肩をすくめて、玄関
に向かおうとする。
dialogues.en:
I shrugged my shoulders as Nemu doesn't seem to get what I
mean, and headed for the entrance.
dialogues.text:
I shrugged my shoulders as Nemu doesn't seem to get what I
mean, and headed for the entrance.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「兄さん！」
dialogues.en: "Niisan!"
dialogues.text: "Niisan!"

dialogues.jp: その背に声がかかった。
dialogues.en: She called me from behind.
dialogues.text: She called me from behind.

dialogues.jp:
裏モードの音夢には珍しく、ちょっとはしゃぎ
気味な感じで。
dialogues.en:
It was a little unusual for her to be this excited at
school.
dialogues.text:
It was a little unusual for her to be this excited at
school.

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「卒業パーティー、楽しみ？」
dialogues.en: "Are you looking forward to the graduation party?"
dialogues.text: "Are you looking forward to the graduation party?"

dialogues.jp: 軽く天井を見上げて考える。
dialogues.en: I thought about it looking at the ceiling.
dialogues.text: I thought about it looking at the ceiling.

dialogues.jp: 「面倒だけど……まぁな」
dialogues.en: "It's too much...... but maybe."
dialogues.text: "It's too much...... but maybe."

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「分かった。私、頑張るからね！」
dialogues.en: "Okay. I'll do my best!"
dialogues.text: "Okay. I'll do my best!"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「だから、頑張るなよ」
dialogues.en: "I told you not to do your best."
dialogues.text: "I told you not to do your best."

dialogues.jp:
思わずにやける口元を隠すように、背中越しに
軽く手を振って別れた。
dialogues.en:
I waved at her facing forward, trying to hide a smile on my
face.
dialogues.text:
I waved at her facing forward, trying to hide a smile on my
face.

dialogues.jp: ◆張り切り音夢さん◆
dialogues.en: ◆Enthusiastic Nemu◆
dialogues.text: ◆Enthusiastic Nemu◆

dialogues.jp:
帰ろうとしたところを音夢に呼び止められる。
風紀委員は見回りなど、何かと忙しいらしい。
dialogues.en:
Nemu stopped me as I was about to go home. The school
committee had the patrolling job and she was pretty busy.
dialogues.text:
Nemu stopped me as I was about to go home. The school
committee had the patrolling job and she was pretty busy.

dialogues.jp:
張り切り過ぎな音夢に釘をさすが、いまいち効
果はなかった。
dialogues.en:
I told Nemu to keep it down, but she seems to be not
listening.
dialogues.text:
I told Nemu to keep it down, but she seems to be not
listening.

dialogues.jp:
俺が卒パを楽しみだと聞き、ますます張り切っ
た様子の音夢だった。
dialogues.en:
Nemu looked really excited as I told her that I was looking
forward to the graduation party.
dialogues.text:
Nemu looked really excited as I told her that I was looking
forward to the graduation party.
